# A01-S69: Artistic report

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

I would especially find it interesting to make an artistic report on the current status of artificial consciousnesses. A bit like your letter to the EU commission, but more experimental in form and with active use of AI. Such a report could also be used as a framework for an exhibition. This approach has been quite widespread in France especially.
